text: Training Objective This course is designed to teach Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and mathematics, etc, after one academic year (Fall and Spring Semesters, totally 36 weeks) continuous study in “Preparatory Course”, students can finally achieve the entry level of bachelor’s programs (offered in Chinese) at UIBE. In other words, and reach HSK 5-6 in Chinese; pass level of College Entrance Exam in mathematics (for arts students), and College English Test band 3 in English. Courses Offered · Chinese: 24 class hours per week · Mathematics: 3 class hours per week · English: 3 class hours per week Term Set · March -July for Spring Semester: · September - January for Fall Semester: (Note: For exact registration time, please refer to Admission Notice) Application Period · April – August 31st for Fall Semester: · October – November 30 for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY11,600/semester CNY 22,300/academic year · Advance payment of CNY2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester
